attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Job Failed
attributes.description: Detects Druva restore or recovery jobs that report a failed state.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects Druva restore or recovery jobs that report a failed state.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
  or druva.event_type:*Recover*
  or druva.event_type:*Restore*
)
and (
  event.outcome:"failure"
  or event.outcome:"failure"
  or message:*failed*
)
